text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh, it's almost the promised time...! Just 
what is that guy after?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, Fenomeno. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san...! Actually, I received what 
looks like a calling card from 
Golshi-san...

text_block_list.name: Calling Card
text_block_list.text:
Tonight at 12, at the deal site where 
hungry fiends gather, the scent of the 
seashore will set off a Night Fever!! 
*Lick*... This taste!? —Phantom Thief 
Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what this means at all, 
sir!! I can sense that she's planning 
something, but...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, I'm not really sure either. 
However... ........."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Um. I'm sorry if I'm mistaken. But, 
could it be—?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phantom Thief Golshi, arriving from the 
rough seas with a heave-ho! I'm gonna 
bundle a packet of ochazuke seasoning with 
every single yakisoba pan sold here~~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot allow that! Tossing in extras 
without permission is a public nuisance!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mame-chin, Verxina. Impressive you 
figured out where I was.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...If you study your races regularly, you 
can see there's a true purpose even behind 
your erratic actions."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"An advance notice, prepared with 
deliberate care... The truth it reveals is 
singular. You are—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You just wanted to play with Fenomeno-san, 
didn't you? Which means you were waiting 
in an obvious spot right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, don't tell me you just 
read my mind?! What is this, Japanese 
class? 'Explain in 20 characters or 
less'?! ...Hah! Fascinating woman.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And for you, a fabulous prize☆ I was gonna 
include this ochazuke seasoning as a 
bonus, but take it all, it's yours! Smell 
ya later!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Guh... It got away! Though I suppose this 
settles the matter for now.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To think someone could read her thoughts! 
That's Verxina-san for you, always 
thoroughly researching her rivals!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is that... really how it is? I'm not sure 
if I should be happy about that or not...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Wait a second. If I can read thoughts 
like this, then even in a race—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, perhaps because she understood 
her peers better, Verxina further refined 
her racing strategy.
